invariants.rationale: Most key-based retrieval methods in frameworks require the name parameter to be non-null; otherwise, a NullPointerException or failure is likely.
The returned result is either null or an instance of Color, as enforced by the get method with Color.class.

invariants.expression: name == null || result == null || result instanceof Color
invariants.rationale: If the provided name is null, the result is typically null or (if not) still must be a Color.
